metadata.title: Baby development during week 1
metadata.text: During week 1 of pregnancy, The fertilized egg begins dividing and preparing for implantation.

metadata.title: Mother changes during week 1
metadata.text: During week 1 of pregnancy, Hormonal changes begin, though symptoms are usually minimal.

metadata.title: Diet during week 1
metadata.text: Recommended foods during week 1 include Start taking folic acid, Eat leafy green vegetables, Stay hydrated.

metadata.title: Exercise during week 1
metadata.text: Recommended exercises during week 1 include Light walking, Gentle stretching.

metadata.title: Water intake during week 1
metadata.text: Recommended water intake during week 1 is 2.5 Liters.

metadata.title: Sleep during week 1
metadata.text: Recommended sleep during week 1 is 8 Hours.

metadata.title: Pregnancy tips during week 1
metadata.text: Avoid alcohol and smoking. Consult your doctor if pregnancy is confirmed.

metadata.title: Baby development during week 18
metadata.text: During week 18 of pregnancy, Baby can hear sounds and is becoming more active.

metadata.title: Mother changes during week 18
metadata.text: During week 18 of pregnancy, You may begin feeling regular baby movements.

metadata.title: Diet during week 18
metadata.text: Recommended foods during week 18 include Iron-rich foods, Protein-rich meals, Fresh fruits.

metadata.title: Exercise during week 18
metadata.text: Recommended exercises during week 18 include Walking, Prenatal yoga.

metadata.title: Water intake during week 18
metadata.text: Recommended water intake during week 18 is 3 Liters.

metadata.title: Sleep during week 18
metadata.text: Recommended sleep during week 18 is 8 Hours.

metadata.title: Pregnancy tips during week 18
metadata.text: Sleep on your left side. Keep attending prenatal checkups.

metadata.title: Baby development during week 25
metadata.text: During week 25 of pregnancy, Baby's lungs continue developing and movement becomes stronger.

metadata.title: Mother changes during week 25
metadata.text: During week 25 of pregnancy, Back pain and leg cramps may increase.

metadata.title: Diet during week 25
metadata.text: Recommended foods during week 25 include Calcium-rich foods, Milk, Nuts.

metadata.title: Exercise during week 25
metadata.text: Recommended exercises during week 25 include Walking, Pelvic exercises.

metadata.title: Water intake during week 25
metadata.text: Recommended water intake during week 25 is 3 Liters.

metadata.title: Sleep during week 25
metadata.text: Recommended sleep during week 25 is 8 Hours.

metadata.title: Pregnancy tips during week 25
metadata.text: Monitor baby's movements. Avoid standing for long periods.

metadata.title: Baby development during week 40
metadata.text: During week 40 of pregnancy, Baby is fully developed and ready for birth.

metadata.title: Mother changes during week 40
metadata.text: During week 40 of pregnancy, Labor may begin at any time.

metadata.title: Diet during week 40
metadata.text: Recommended foods during week 40 include Balanced meals, Stay hydrated.

metadata.title: Exercise during week 40
metadata.text: Recommended exercises during week 40 include Light walking.

metadata.title: Water intake during week 40
metadata.text: Recommended water intake during week 40 is 3 Liters.

metadata.title: Sleep during week 40
metadata.text: Recommended sleep during week 40 is 8 Hours.

metadata.title: Pregnancy tips during week 40
metadata.text: Keep your hospital bag ready. Contact your doctor if contractions begin.
